alarm_arm_automatic.name: Arm automatic
alarm_arm_automatic.description: Arms Elk E27 areas from automations, such as geofence- or occupancy-based arming when everyone leaves. Open (faulted) zones in each targeted area are bypassed before arming; zones in other areas are not changed. It cancels auto-stay and the exit delay so the area arms immediately. Refusals are never retried; if a bypass or the arm is refused, the area is not armed and the bypasses it made are undone. If the arm result is unknown (for example a timeout), the bypasses are left in place and you are told to check the panel. An area that is already armed is left unchanged.

code.description: Numeric alarm user code used to arm the area.

zone_bypass.name: Bypass zone
zone_bypass.description: Bypasses Elk E27 zones so they are ignored while the area is armed, or removes the bypass. Disarming an armed area clears all bypasses; disarming an area that is already disarmed does not.

code.name: Code
code.description: Numeric alarm user code used to bypass the zone.

bypass.name: Bypass
bypass.description: Turn on to bypass the zone, off to remove the bypass.
